findings.why_it_matters: The CURRENT-DATE character-position table is broken: its column headings sit outside the table as a mangled prose line ("Character Contents\ Positions"), the table ends at row 13-14, the two LEAP-SECOND sub-items are detached from the 13-14 row, and rows 15-16, 17, 18-19 and 20-21 fall out as unstructured indented paragraphs. The 15-16 row is further split mid-sentence ("in the range 00 through" / "99\. The value 00 ..."), so its upper bound 99 is detached into a separate paragraph that markdown renders as a stray numbered fragment. All text is present; the table structure that ties each position range to its contents is lost.
